Skylos Sports Medicine – a BluePearl Pet Hospital.
Skylos believes there is an inner athlete in every dog. We are committed to working with you to unleash that potential, whether your companion athlete requires orthopedic surgery, rehabilitation therapy, or return to sport and fitness.
We are located in Woodstock, Maryland, and serve pets in Ellicott City, Baltimore, the DMV area, and beyond.
Conditions we treat:
Stifle (Knee)
Stifle (Knee)
-Cranial cruciate ligament rupture:
-TPLO
-TightRope stabilization
-Lateral suture and/or anchor stabilization
-Medial patella luxation (MPL)
-Lateral patella luxation (LPL)
-Femoral condyle osteochondritis dissecans
Coxofemoral Joint (Hip)
Coxofemoral Joint (Hip)
-Treatment of juvenile hip dysplasia
-Juvenile pubic symphysiodesis (JPS)
-Triple or double pelvic osteotomy (TPO or DPO)
-Treatment of adult hip dysplasia
-Total hip replacement (THR)
-Femoral head ostectomy (FHO)
-Hip dislocation surgery (Hip Toggle)
Shoulder
Shoulder
-Humeral head osteochondritis dissecans (OCD)
-Supraspinatus tendinopathy
-Infraspinatus tendinopathy
-Medial shoulder syndrome
-Biceps tendon injury
-Shoulder dislocation
Elbow
Elbow
-Fragmented medial coronoid process (FCP)
-Humeral condyle osteochondritis dissecans (OCD)
-Ununited anconeal process
-Incomplete humeral ossification
-Elbow dislocation
Carpus (Wrist)
Carpus (Wrist)
-Carpal hyperextension injuries
-Flexor carpi ulnaris strains
-Collateral ligament injury
Tarsus (Ankle/Hock)
Tarsus (Ankle/Hock)
-Superficial digital flexor tendon luxation repair
-Common calcanean tendon rupture repair
-Talus osteochondritis dissecans (OCD)
-Collateral ligament injury

-Sesmoiditis

About Skylos Sports Medicine.
The vision for Skylos Sports Medicine was developed in 2015 and is the realization of Dr. Peter and Faith Lotsikas' united dream of providing personalized orthopedic and rehabilitation therapy for the canine companion.
Our mission is to restore and maintain the basic canine freedom to feel good and run for the fun of it. To uphold our vision, we have endeavored to create the best possible environment for those who work here and those who visit us, human and canine alike. We also believe in supporting global sustainability efforts, and leverage the
Mars Sustainability Plan
to act with purpose and intention.
Our hospital provides a unique orthopedic and rehabilitation team focused on treating and preventing injury, aiding recovery, and enhancing performance. Helping dogs live well is what drives us.

Testimonials.
Thank you simply isn’t a big enough work to express how truly grateful we are for everything you’ve done for Rusty. To see him moving the way a 2 year old should move – without pain – feels like a miracle. From the initial diagnosis, to orthopedic surgery, to recovery and physical therapy, your entire team took amazing care of Rusty (and of his mommy). I know you will understand when I say I hope I never have to see you again, but I will always be grateful for your skill and compassion. Thank you again!

The doctor and staff go beyond to make your pet feel loved. Our dog Zoe had ACL and MCL surgery at Skylos and we highly recommend going there to get treated. The staff is awesome and very attentive. Zoe is doing great and is a very happy dog.

We had to bring our cat Seamus here for orthopedic surgery after he broke his leg, and the service from start to finish was top tier.  From the front desk, to all the techs, the doctor, plus everyone we spoke to on the phone every single person we dealt with was so friendly and caring.  We will always recommend Skylos to anyone in need of an orthopedic surgeon!

Olivia S.
We are so grateful to the entire team at Skylos Sports Medicine for the incredible care they gave our sweet Emily. After our family vet discovered an issue with her ACL and referred us for a consult, we immediately felt we were in the best hands possible. The medical team was kind, compassionate, patient, and truly caring every step of the way.
Emily’s orthopedic surgery went wonderfully, and we are so happy to see her getting stronger and doing better every single day. The love, attention, and professionalism shown to both Emily and our family meant more to us than words can express.

We had a wonderful experience with Skylos. From our very first call to schedule a consult through the day after orthopedic surgery, every single staff member was amazing. We especially appreciated the open communication and the continued updates on our sweet girl throughout the entire process. Their compassion, professionalism, and care made such a stressful time so much easier. We are incredibly grateful and highly recommend them!

My entire family will be singing your praises to all with ears for years and years. We are so appreciative of the entire staff!

Our experience with the doctor was great! My dog underwent a total hip replacement and he was extremely helpful and kind throughout the entire process. My dog’s healing process was extremely straightforward and easy, the PT exercises were easy to follow, and she is now able to do everything she wants to do without restriction. I would make this choice a thousand times again.

The quality of service provided is unmatched! Every staff member is friendly, extremely knowledgeable and dedicated to caring for your pet. My dog was treated with such great care after her orthopedic surgery and we were able to check on her progress 24/7. The doctor is amazing! He's such a personable and professional surgeon that gives a thorough diagnosis and honest prognosis. Very trustworthy!
